headline: JLR恐裁員政府拒紓困
context: 英國最大車廠捷豹路虎（Jaguar Land Rover, JLR）傳出最多裁減4000個職位，英國政府則表態不會動用公帑紓困。商業大臣強納森．雷諾茲（Jonathan Reynolds）在與工會、公司代表會談前表示，介入經營企業不是他的職責。JLR近來受到美國關稅與中國競爭對手的雙重夾擊。

sources.name: The Guardian
sources.summary: Carmaker, which is battling Trump tariffs and Chinese competitors, faces talks with union leaders and government The government has signalled that it will not invest taxpayers’ money to limit job losses at Jaguar Land Rover (JLR), after it emerged that the UK’s biggest carmaker is planning up to 4,000 redundancies . Before crunch talks on Tuesday between JLR, union leaders and government officials, the business secretary, Jonathan Reynolds, said it was not his job to “intervene and run businesses”. Continue reading...
sources.title: No bailouts for Jaguar Land Rover amid reports of thousands of job cuts, says minister

sources.name: BBC
sources.summary: The company is struggling with the impact of tariffs as well as the fallout from a major cyber attack last year.
sources.title: Minister to meet Jaguar Land Rover boss as thousands of job cuts expected

voice_text: 英國最大車廠傳出大裁員，政府說不會紓困。捷豹路虎最多可能裁減4000個職位，英國政府表態不會動用公帑介入。商業大臣強納森．雷諾茲說，介入經營企業不是他的職責。這家公司最近受到美國關稅和中國競爭對手的雙重夾擊。
